summary: An incident occurred where the external payment service provider (PSP) began returning HTTP 429 Too Many Requests (rate limiting). This caused payments to fail with psp_rate_limited errors, which in turn caused orders checkouts to fail.

hypotheses.summary: The external payment service provider (PSP) is rate-limiting charge requests with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests, causing payments and orders to fail.

evidence.quote: psp rejected charge: 429 Too Many Requests
evidence.shows: The external payment service provider (PSP) is returning HTTP 429 Too Many Requests, rate-limiting payment charges.

evidence.quote: POST /orders failed: payments POST /payments/charge failed: 503 Service Unavailable: "{\"error\":\"psp_rate_limited"
evidence.shows: Payments fails to charge due to PSP rate limiting, causing orders checkout requests to fail with 503 Service Unavailable.

hypotheses.suggested_fix: Contact the payment service provider (PSP) to raise the rate limit, or reduce outgoing request rate and avoid aggressive retries.
